_about: The Lull belt, Lullford and the delta as a plan (Claude I, lane I), v2: Claude F's region-plan schema (#174). The water, the coast and the tiers come from the block-out (docs/vision/research/blockout/blockout-v52.json (#187, claude-a/blockout-data)); the routes are lane G's grid routes (lib/world-routes.ts on claude-g/routes (#175) ef8824f); every outline is in the grid shape on 16 px cells (Matt, 21 Oct 11:44). The plain's low tiers are merged into banks that agree with G's route tiers (local 0 = world 2). Things moved to fit keep the brief's point as moved_from. Painted by scripts/art/regions/lull_delta.py.

ground._about: Ground kinds by place, for the painter, in the river and meadow kit's terms; colours from the house ramps per terrain.
ground.plain: hay meadows and pasture in hedged fields, copses of oak and ash, a hay barn
ground.water_meadows: lush cool grass, rushes and marsh marigold in wet flushes along the Lull's banks, pollarded willows
ground.carr: willow and alder carr on wet wood floor, brambles, fallen trees
ground.lullford: cobbled lanes and setts at the bridge foot, cottage gardens behind stone walls, a green with the pump
ground.delta: reed beds between the arms, marsh, mudflats in front with sandbars at the mouths, boardwalks
ground.coast: dunes with marram behind a sand and shingle beach west of the delta
